endorsements.name: Murat Aydemir
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-3721
endorsements.description: Dell EMC Open Manage System Administrator (OMSA) versions prior to 9.3.0 contain an Improper Range Header Processing Vulnerability. A remote unauthenticated attacker may send crafted requests with overlapping ranges to cause the application to compress each of the requested bytes, resulting in a crash due to excessive memory consumption and preventing users from accessing the system.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.0, 4.3)
